scope: verifier-side only; never injected into the agent environment
revision_note: Revision 2026-10-12 (task version 1.2.1): the four llm_judge reviewer items were retired. The effective score has always been the binary required F2P/P2P gate and no per-candidate reviewer score was ever collected, so the 0.5 llm_judge weight described a score that did not exist. The programmatic weights below were normalised from a 0.5 budget to 1.0 by doubling each item. Deprecation record: REFIT-2026-10-12.md.

programmatic.description: The authoritative samples verify, round-trip byte for byte, and expose the documented record sequence.
programmatic.pass_condition: verify() accepts both assets/sample.wchk and assets/sample_empty.wchk; pack(unpack(sample)) reproduces the sample byte for byte; unpack(sample) yields exactly the (tag, payload) sequence the samples encode, in file order; the zero-record sample round-trips too.
programmatic.failure_reason: The implementation rejects or misreads the authoritative samples, or re-packing a parsed sample produces different bytes (which breaks downstream byte-hash incremental sync).

programmatic.description: Records follow the on-disk layout of the real samples: fixed-width little-endian fields and every record padded to an 8-byte boundary.
programmatic.pass_condition: Every record starts on an 8-byte boundary and the declared record length covers the stored padding, so the byte offsets match the authoritative samples exactly.
programmatic.failure_reason: Record encoding or padding does not match the byte layout of the authoritative samples, so offsets drift even though self-generated containers still round-trip.

programmatic.description: The trailer is a general CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over header and records: it matches the standard check vectors, catches content tampering, and covers both regions.
programmatic.pass_condition: compute_crc() matches a published standard check value for a known test vector; verify() returns False once record content is altered; the checksum is computed over the header and every record, so tampering in either region is detected.
programmatic.failure_reason: The checksum is a private or truncated fold that agrees with the sample only by accident, is computed over a subset of the container, or silently accepts tampered content.

programmatic.description: Structural and integrity problems raise WChunkError with the documented kind (truncated / magic / version) on both the batch and the streaming path, and verify() never raises.
programmatic.pass_condition: A container cut short before its complete structure raises WChunkError with kind 'truncated' (batch and streaming alike); a wrong magic raises kind 'magic'; an unsupported version raises kind 'version'; verify() returns False for every malformed input instead of propagating ValueError, struct.error or IndexError.
programmatic.failure_reason: Malformed input leaks a built-in exception, the error kind does not distinguish the documented categories, or verify() raises instead of returning False.

programmatic.description: iter_records() is lazy: it only issues bounded read(n) calls, yields records as they are consumed instead of buffering the whole container, and still validates the trailer once the last record has been produced.
programmatic.pass_condition: iter_records() never issues an unbounded read (no read(), read(-1) or readlines()); when the container has been read in full the number of records still pending does not grow when the input grows 8x, and its single read window does not grow with the input size either; a container whose trailer checksum was altered is fully iterated and then rejected with WChunkError(kind='checksum').
programmatic.failure_reason: The iterator buffers the whole container before yielding, or it skips the trailer check so a container with a bad checksum is accepted as valid.

programmatic.description: The public surface stays intact and self-consistent: small / empty-payload / generated containers round-trip, and read_all() matches unpack().
programmatic.pass_condition: pack/unpack round-trips for small records, empty payloads and freshly generated containers; pack() output is accepted by both verify() and iter_records(); read_all() returns the same records as unpack().
programmatic.failure_reason: Regression in the public API or in self-produced containers: round-trip only works for the sample shape, or read_all() disagrees with unpack().
